Kept the canonical four clusters; no new cluster was needed for this room.
Room area and center openness support a compact optional island only if downstream surplus remains after core workflow and dining are placed.
13.69 m2 kitchen supports a full perimeter workflow plus a compact dining core; island is optional and should yield first to circulation.
Keep small support items like dishwasher and chairs only when surplus is comfortable; avoid over-pruning them if the room still has clear center openness.
Prefer compact/S profiles for optional and support pieces; preserve the main workflow quartet and dining table as the deterministic backbone.
kitchen_workflow_core treated as primary due to full-function workflow and longest-wall preference.

storage remains wall-bound; island is optional and must preserve entry/circulation clearance.
